default.title: Wordhabit — Master a new word every day
default.description: Wordhabit helps you build a daily vocabulary habit with spaced repetition, flashcards, and gamified progress.

home.title: Wordhabit — Master a new word every day
home.description: Wordhabit turns vocabulary into a daily ritual. Flashcards, quizzes, and streaks designed to make words stick — for real.
home.ogDescription: Build a lasting vocabulary habit with daily words, flashcards, and streaks designed to make words stick.
home.twitterDescription: Learn better words daily with spaced repetition and flashcards that are actually fun to use.

primary.description: Wordhabit is a mobile app that turns vocabulary into a daily ritual. Flashcards, quizzes, and streaks designed to make words stick — for real.

big.description: Build a vocabulary you actually use. One beautiful word a day.

phone.description: A 5-minute habit that makes you sharper, more articulate, and impossible to ignore at dinner parties.

features.description: Most vocab apps drown you in lists. We use spaced repetition, real context, and just enough game design to make daily practice feel like a treat.

flashcards.title: Smart flashcards
flashcards.description: Spaced repetition that knows when you’re about to forget — and shows up just in time.

dailyWord.title: Word of the day
dailyWord.description: A new word each morning, hand-picked for usefulness, beauty, and the occasional showoff.

streaks.title: Badges & streaks
streaks.description: Build a 100-day streak. Unlock 30+ collector badges. Find out what kind of word nerd you are.

quizzes.title: Quizzes that stick
quizzes.description: Quick daily challenges. Multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, audio. Five minutes, real recall.

interests.title: Pick your interests
interests.description: Science, business, literature, slang. Words tailored to your world — not a generic word list.

friends.title: Learn with friends
friends.description: Share wins, race streaks, send words. Vocabulary is more fun when it’s a group habit.

interests.title: Pick what excites you
interests.description: Science, history, business, slang — choose interests so we serve words you’ll actually use.

daily.title: Five minutes a day
daily.description: A new word in the morning. A quick review at lunch. A flashcard sweep at night. That’s it.

compound.title: Watch it compound
compound.description: After 30 days you’ve banked 30 words. After a year, you’re fluent in a richer version of yourself.

launch.question: When does Wordhabit launch?
launch.answer: We’re rolling out access waves throughout 2026. Waitlist members get in first — and at half price for the first year.

devices.question: Will it work on my phone?
devices.answer: Yes. We’re launching iOS and Android first.

dictionary.question: How is this different from a dictionary app?
dictionary.answer: Dictionaries are for lookups. Wordhabit is for retention. We use spaced repetition, real-life examples, and quizzes so words actually move from “I’ve seen that” to “I use that.”

duration.question: How long is a daily session?
duration.answer: Five minutes. The whole point is that it’s short enough to do every day — that’s where the habit lives.

languages.question: Do you support languages other than English?
languages.answer: Right now: English and French, with Spanish, German, and Japanese coming through 2026.
